items.q: What is Karpathy's mental model of ChatGPT?
items.a: A **lossy ~1 TB zip file** (~1 trillion parameters) of the internet, cutoff months-to-a-year old, plus a post-trained 'smiley face.' By default: **no calculator, no Python, no web.**

items.q: What are the chat bubbles actually doing?
items.a: You and the model **co-author one 1-D token stream**. Tiktokenizer: haiku prompt **15 tokens**, reply **19**, two bubbles with special tokens **42**. New Chat wipes working memory.

sections.title: Pick the model, then the tool

items.q: Why does he say 'know which model you are using'?
items.a: Incognito ChatGPT **hides the model** (likely 4o-mini). Plus: **80 × GPT-4o / 3 hours**. Pro $200: o1 Pro + Deep Research. Don't ask Grok 2 if Grok 3 exists.

items.q: When do thinking models earn the extra minute?
items.a: **Hard math/code only.** Try fast non-thinking first. GPT-4o missed his gradient bug; **o1 Pro thought ~1 minute** and found the param mismatch. Travel advice does not need a think bubble.
He **pays several labs** and asks all of them the same question — vacation, the gradient bug, anything he will not trust from one zip file.

items.q: What does search actually do under the hood?
items.a: The model emits a **search token**, the app fetches pages, **thousands of tokens** land in the window, then it answers with citations. Perplexity was his habit; Claude had **no search** at filming.

items.q: How should you treat Deep Research?
items.a: As a **first draft with citations**, not truth. Ca-AKG: 5 min / 27 sources. His US LLM-labs table **dropped xAI** and wrongly listed Hugging Face.

items.q: How does he read books with an LLM?
items.a: **Don't read books alone.** Paste the **chapter you are on**. Claude 'knows' *Wealth of Nations* vaguely but **not Book I ch.3**.

items.q: What is Advanced Data Analysis actually like?
items.a: A **junior, absent-minded analyst**. It plots OpenAI valuations, then silently maps 2015 N/A → $100M and claims $1.7T vs a printed ~$20T. Read the code.
In **Cursor Composer** with Claude 3.7: empty project → React tic-tac-toe from ~five sentences. 'Giving control to Composer and **hoping that it works**.' He still confirms shell commands.

items.q: What is Advanced Voice vs the mic button?
items.a: Mic = **fake audio** (STT → text). Advanced Voice = **true audio** (~100k spectrogram chunks, no text in the loop). Desktop: Super Whisper F5. Phone: ~80% speech.
**Not a new model** — a saved few-shot prompt. Korean Anki extractor, translator, screenshot OCR. 'There's nothing new and special going on.'
